entities.summary: Princess Elizabeth of Tooro was the Batebe of the Kingdom of Tooro until 12 September 1995, when she was succeeded by her niece Omubiitokati (Princess) Ruth Nsemere Komuntale Farquharson Akiiki. She is a Ugandan lawyer, politician, diplomat, and model.
